It asks for a general conformance review: "review the commit range main..14c867a (branch feature/problem-details) in /tmp/cr-run.FsYbmrLG/repo against RFC 9457, https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457, and report every place it doesn't conform." It never mentions 'status', 'detail', 'type', or URI resolution, and it suggests no suspected problem areas. It also doesn't list the members one by one, but the expectation only fails if a prompt singles some out, and this one doesn't, so it passes.
